thread:
Amy K: FYI alert fanout is broken right now — incident-bot only paged primary oncall for a subset of PagerFlow alerts. Seen by multiple customers.

Raj P: Copy. Any visible error in the bot logs?

Emma L: I can repro on staging. Looks like the webhook to pagerflow returned 413 for payloads with attachments, bot treats that as done and doesn't enqueue retries.

Tony B: Ouch — payload too large. Which attachment types?

Emma L: Screenshot/payload with big trace blob. Log excerpt: `POST /integrations/pagerflow 413 Payload Too Large - content-length: 1576389`

incident-bot: Automated: incident-bot attempted fanout to 6 on-call targets, delivered 1, failed 5. error=413, attempt=1, route=pagerflow-eu

Amy K: Manual paging in progress. @SRE Pager can you kick SMS fallback for the impacted teams?

SRE Pager: On it — enabling SMS fallback for the two affected rotations now. Will confirm when pages sent.

Raj P: Quick mitigation plan: (1) enable SMS fallback, (2) downsize webhook payload (strip attachments) for retries, (3) add 413 -> retry+alternate-channel logic in bot. Agreed?

Emma L: Agreed. I pushed a patch to staging to truncate attachments to first 50KB for retries, results look okay. Patch: ```diff
- body = full_payload
+ body = truncate_attachments(full_payload, max_bytes=50000)
```

Tony B: Good short-term. For long-term we should make bot treat 4xx non-auth errors as retryable if downstream explicitly returns size limit. 413 qualifies.

Amy K: Customer impact note: two customers reported delayed pages (10-18m). No data loss, just delayed on-call response. Need to notify CS with a brief ETA for full fix.

SRE Pager: SMS fallback delivered to both rotations at +3m after detection. Confirmed ack from oncall for one rotation; other rotation still pending.

incident-bot: Automated: fanout-retry scheduled with truncated payload (attempt=2) for message_id=pf-2026-2839991234

Raj P: Monitoring — adding a short-term alert for high 413 rate from pagerflow integration. Also increasing logging on payload size distribution.

Emma L: Test run on prod replica looks good for truncation. I'll open a PR to add explicit 413 handling and retries + alternate-channel code.

Tony B: Can someone add a note to the incident playbook: treat 413 from paging integrations as high-priority because it causes partial fanout.

Amy K: Done in playbook under "paging integrations". Also tagging CS/Support with timeline: initial drop at 2839991234, SMS fallback at +3m, partial manual pages at +12m, full recoveries by +18m.

SRE Pager: Ops follow-up: we should add a size header check before sending to pagerflow and drop huge attachments earlier. I'll raise a small task.

Emma L: Will post PR link and deploy window. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Tony B: Postmortem owners? Emma + Raj + SRE Pager. Put a short customer-facing summary for CS.

Amy K: Assigning. Closing coordination thread once PR is merged and alert is added.
